extracted.name: Chef John's Ranch Dressing
extracted.description: Ranch dressing is quick and easy to make at home. Just combine mayonnaise, sour cream, buttermilk, and herbs for a thick and creamy salad topping.
instruction_lines: Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, and buttermilk in a large bowl. Stir in parsley, chives, dill, tarragon, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, cayenne pepper, salt, and Worcestershire sauce until combined.
Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours to overnight. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
